headline: Bitcoin Tops $61,000 as U.S. Equity Futures Extend Rebound
summary: Bitcoin surpassed $61,000 while U.S. equity futures extended their rebound following Thanksgiving, with AI infrastructure stocks leading premarket gains.
why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market capitalization, and its price movements often reflect broader risk sentiment across global financial and technology markets.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: The headline explicitly states Bitcoin topped $61,000.
